# Flat Submodule Worktree Creation Defect
Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 repo cannot directly create a "flat submodule worktree" in this environment; must use parent worktree + nested submodule structure.

## Description
- Direct `git worktree add` inside the submodule repo (zhi2-web-admin) to a flat path makes git misjudge the toplevel as a common dir (.git/modules/...), showing all tracked files deleted; reproduces even with a pure ASCII path, while the nested structure works normally.
- Build config `rootDir = resolve(__dirname,"../")` couples output to the parent repo, so the submodule worktree must sit inside the parent root (e.g. `…\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358`) for `../` to resolve and `dist/`+`env/` to land correctly.
- `node_modules` exists only in the parent root and `zhi2-web-admin/`; parent-root vite is 5.4.11 but the submodule declares 8.3.5, so an in-parent worktree must junction its `node_modules` to `zhi2-web-admin/node_modules` for correct vite 8.3.5.
- The main submodule `node_modules` can be wiped by parallel tasks (e.g. payfund/portal-skeleton worktree reinstall), breaking the junction and failing vite 8.3.5 (2026-11-09 session); `install.mjs` at parent `门户/scripts/install.mjs` only runs `npm install -f` at the parent root (vite 5.4.11) and cannot supply submodule vite 8.3.5.
- Reliable fix: remove the dead junction and run an independent `npm install` inside the worktree (vite locked 8.3.5, Node v22.23.2, no lockfile, no workspaces hoist); 834 packages installed, build passes, fully decoupled from the shared dir.

## Workflow
- Adopt the nested "parent repo worktree + submodule" pattern used by bug-6324/6326/6322 worktrees: from the parent repo run `git worktree add`, then init the inner zhi2-web-admin submodule and switch to the target branch.
- Base branch is `develop/v3.0.0`; concrete example `苏州市房地产监测V3-wt-bug-6372` uses a parent-level worktree with `node_modules` as a ReparsePoint (junction) to the main tree and the submodule on a matching branch; the same pattern was replicated for bug 6373.
- Verify with `git -C <wt> rev-parse --show-toplevel`; it must return the worktree root, not a .git/modules path.

## Removal Quirk
- `git worktree remove` refuses a worktree that contains a submodule checkout; even `git submodule deinit` (which clears files) still leaves the gitlink so git treats the submodule as present.
- Workaround: manually remove the worktree directory, then run `git worktree prune` to clear stale metadata; the shared submodule module dir and already-pushed commits stay safe.

## Relations
- Repos: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3 (parent) + zhi2-web-admin (submodule)
- Source session: 2026-11-09 session (LpbStatisticsDialog fix pitfall, bug-6363 worktree removal, bug-6372/6373 pattern)

# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Globally mounted as `<image-viewer />` overlay; the dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the trigger, dispatched by `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` and drivable via `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` in Playwright.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules; Vue is injected via a build-time `<%- injectVue %>` placeholder that loads a global `vue.js`/`vue.min.js`, and `element-ui.js` is a global `defer` script expecting global `Vue`.
- `main.js` exposes `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` and `window.__VUE_APP_ROUTER__` globally, enabling Playwright to drive the real `ImageViewer` without login.

## Bug Hypotheses
- Hypothesis A: `dialogVisible` setter calls `handleClose()` → `closePreview`; if `handleClose` throws (e.g. `stopDrag`/`stopResize`), setter fails and `showViewer` stays `true`, so dialog never closes. RULED OUT: `stopDrag`/`stopResize` are safe, `handleClose` does not throw.
- Hypothesis B: drag directive swallows the X close click. RULED OUT: `zs-dialog` uses the same `v-dialogDrag` directive and closes fine; drag math causes no X displacement.

## Bug 6373 Status
- Worktree created on submodule branch `fix/bug-6373-preview-close`; `node_modules` junctions placed to parent root (npm workspaces hoists deps there), so build resolves from parent root as of 2026-11-09.
- Close path provably correct down to `el-dialog` internals; dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`, and `<image-viewer />` is globally mounted.
- Empirical confirmation (2026-11-09): Playwright repro on the live 8098 nginx buggy build opened preview via `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` and clicked X; after click `showViewer` stays `true` and `.custom-image-viewer` wrapper persists (`wrapperAfter: 1`) with zero console errors — bug reproduced.
- Next step: instrument the repro to capture whether the close-button click fires and whether the drag directive mutates `.el-dialog` to `position:absolute` on the X mousedown, to find the actual close mechanism failure.

# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Globally mounted as `<image-viewer />` overlay; the dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the trigger, dispatched by `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` and drivable via `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` in Playwright.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules; Vue is injected via a build-time `<%- injectVue %>` placeholder that loads a global `vue.js`/`vue.min.js`, and `element-ui.js` is a global `defer` script expecting global `Vue`.
- `main.js` exposes `window.__VUE_APP_STORE__` and `window.__VUE_APP_ROUTER__` globally, enabling Playwright to drive the real `ImageViewer` without login.

## Bug Hypotheses
- Hypothesis A: `dialogVisible` setter calls `handleClose()` → `closePreview`; if `handleClose` throws (e.g. `stopDrag`/`stopResize`), setter fails and `showViewer` stays `true`, so dialog never closes. RULED OUT: `stopDrag`/`stopResize` are safe, `handleClose` does not throw.
- Hypothesis B: drag directive swallows the X close click. CONFIRMED (2026-11-09): `v-dialogDrag` on `.el-dialog__header` catches the close button (`.el-dialog__headerbtn`) mousedown and sets `.el-dialog { position: absolute }`, so the browser cancels the click (mousedown/mouseup land on different nodes) and X won't close; regression from commit `a20c15dcc`.

## Bug 6373 Status
- Worktree created on submodule branch `fix/bug-6373-preview-close` based on frozen base `2eb1e3ba7` (matching parent worktree gitlink, not current `develop/v3.0.0` tip `05a1a4421`); `node_modules` junctions placed to parent root (npm workspaces hoists deps there), so build resolves from parent root as of 2026-11-09.
- Close path provably correct down to `el-dialog` internals; dev-company page triggers preview via `AnnexUpload`/`ZsImg` → `preview/openPreview`, and `<image-viewer />` is globally mounted.
- Root cause confirmed (2026-11-09): `v-dialogDrag` on `.el-dialog__header` catches the close button (`.el-dialog__headerbtn`) mousedown, sets `.el-dialog { position: absolute }`, so the browser cancels the click (mousedown/mouseup land on different nodes) and X won't close. Regression from commit `a20c15dcc`.
- Fix applied (2026-11-09): added a guard in `drag.js` so a mousedown on the close button never starts a drag; build on `fix/bug-6373-preview-close` succeeded and lint passed (exit 0).
- Fix verified (2026-11-09): against a temporary nginx 8099 site serving the fixed `dist`, Playwright repro showed dialog closes (`after: false`, `posAfter: "NO_DIALOG"`), close-button `click` fires (`diag.click: 1`, was `0` on buggy build), no console errors.
- Open issue (2026-11-09): after the fix, `git status` in the submodule worktree showed hundreds of deletions because its `.git` file pointed to a mojibake (garbled) path of `苏州市房地产监测V3`; the linked-worktree `commondir`/registration also appears affected and was still under investigation.
